COMICCHESS-GEM_FLAME.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Corrode this card into [purple]Bound[/purple].

COMICCHESS-MIASMA_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply 3 [gold]Poison[/gold], [gold]Doom[/gold], or [gold]Demise[/gold] at random.

COMICCHESS-RETURN_TO_SILENCE.description:

COMICCHESS-SUBMIT_TO_ME.title: Submit to Me!
COMICCHESS-SUBMIT_TO_ME.description:

THE_QUEEN_CARD_SUBMIT_TO_ME.title: Submit to Me!

COMICCHESS-UNFINISHED_CALAMITY.title: Unfinished Calamity

COMICCHESS-PATH_OF_PAIN.description: Stackable. Whenever you play a card, apply [gold]Poison[/gold], [gold]Doom[/gold], or [gold]Demise[/gold] at random to a random enemy, equal to your stacks of Path of Pain.

THE_QUEEN_CARD_DEATH_TORRENT.description: Apply {TriadStacks:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold], [gold]Doom[/gold], or [gold]Demise[/gold] at random to ALL enemies. If there is only 1 enemy, [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
THE_QUEEN_CARD_CATACLYSM.title: Cataclysm
THE_QUEEN_CARD_CATACLYSM.description: The next {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} times the target takes unblocked Attack damage, apply a random [gold]Poison[/gold], [gold]Doom[/gold], or [gold]Demise[/gold] equal to that damage.
COMICCHESS-GEM_SHIELD.title: Gem Shield
COMICCHESS-GEM_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}{IfUpgraded:show: and [aqua]1 Soul Lamp[/aqua]|}.
COMICCHESS-GEM_CHARGE.title: Gem Charge
COMICCHESS-GEM_CHARGE.description:
Create a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Piercing Charge+|Piercing Charge}[/gold] and a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Diffuse Charge+|Diffuse Charge}[/gold].

COMICCHESS-SWIPE.title: Swipe
COMICCHESS-SWIPE.description:
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] deals {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage and steals that enemy's Monster Card. After {AmalgamEscapePower:diff()} turns, your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] flees.
[purple]Bound[/purple]
[gold]Exhaust[/gold]
COMICCHESS-STEAM_ERUPTION.title: Steam Eruption
COMICCHESS-STEAM_ERUPTION.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] gains {AmalgamSteamEruptionPower:diff()} [gold]Steam Eruption[/gold].
Whenever your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] acts, it gains 3 [gold]Steam Eruption[/gold].
Whenever your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] falls asleep, deal damage equal to its [gold]Steam Eruption[/gold] to ALL enemies.
COMICCHESS-BECKON.title: Beckon
COMICCHESS-BECKON.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
At the start of each turn, add a [gold]Beckon[/gold] into your Hand.
At the end of your turn, if there are no [gold]Beckon[/gold] cards in your Hand, gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold].
COMICCHESS-CORPSE_SLUG_HUNGER.title: Hunger
COMICCHESS-DRAIN_LIFE.title: Drain Life
COMICCHESS-SOUL_SIPHON.title: Soul Siphon
COMICCHESS-SOUL_SIPHON.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold]{Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn intent[/gold]: All enemies lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. You gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
COMICCHESS-FLAMETHROWER.title: Flamethrower
COMICCHESS-FLAMETHROWER.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Draw {LearnIntentDraw:diff()} cards and Enchant them with [purple]Burn[/purple] {LearnIntentBurn:diff()}. Next turn, deal {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage.
COMICCHESS-FLAIL.title: Flail
COMICCHESS-THE_KINS.title: The Kins!
COMICCHESS-THE_KINS.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
Create [blue]{GenerateCount:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Power Dance[/gold].
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Deal {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage. Apply {LearnIntentWeak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Deal {LearnIntentDamage2:diff()} damage. The target loses {LearnIntentStrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
COMICCHESS-POWER_DANCE.title: Power Dance
COMICCHESS-SLIPPERY.title: Slippery
COMICCHESS-ENERGY_ORB.title: Energy Orb
COMICCHESS-BEAST_CRY.title: Beast Cry
COMICCHESS-BEAST_CRY.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Stun all enemies for [blue]1[/blue] turn. Sleep for [blue]2[/blue] turns.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold]
COMICCHESS-ALL_SLIPPERY.title: All Slippery
COMICCHESS-SOUL_CALM_CASKET.title: Soul Calm Casket
COMICCHESS-SOUL_CALM_CASKET.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target is at or below {IfUpgraded:show:15|10}% HP, double this damage.
On [gold]Fatal[/gold], [gold]Capture[/gold] the target.
THE_QUEEN_CARD_SQUEEZE_BLOOD.title: Squeeze Blood
THE_QUEEN_CARD_SQUEEZE_BLOOD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has 3 or more debuffs, deal double damage.
THE_QUEEN_CARD_SELF_DESTRUCT.title: Self-Destruct
THE_QUEEN_CARD_SELF_DESTRUCT.description:
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] loses all HP, then deal damage equal to the HP lost to ALL enemies.{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)|}
COMICCHESS-RELEASE.title: Release
COMICCHESS-RELEASE.description: Do not add this card to your deck. On obtain, choose {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} [gold]Monster Card[/gold] and remove it from your deck.
COMICCHESS-MARIONETTE.title: Marionette
COMICCHESS-MARIONETTE.description: Gain the target's [gold]Monster Card[/gold]. After 3 turns, permanently add that card to your deck.
COMICCHESS-FRENZIED_BITE.title: Frenzied Bite
COMICCHESS-FRENZIED_BITE.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] takes its action {Actions:diff()} times in a row, then [gold]forgets[/gold] all intents.
THE_QUEEN_CARD_FRENZIED_BITE.title: Frenzied Bite
THE_QUEEN_CARD_FRENZIED_BITE.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] takes its action {Actions:diff()} times in a row, then [gold]forgets[/gold] all intents.
COMICCHESS-EXECUTION.title: Execution
COMICCHESS-EXECUTION.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. For each debuff on the target, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
On [gold]Fatal[/gold], [gold]Capture[/gold] the target.
COMICCHESS-QUICK_ADAPTATION.title: Quick Adaptation
COMICCHESS-QUICK_ADAPTATION.description:
Choose {Pick:diff()} [gold]Learn Intent[/gold] card(s) from your draw pile and play them automatically.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THE_QUEEN_CARD_QUICK_ADAPTATION.selectio: Choose {Amount:plural:a [gold]Learn Intent[/gold] card|[gold]Learn Intent[/gold] {} cards} from your draw pile.
COMICCHESS-DECLARATION.title: Declaration
COMICCHESS-DECLARATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target dies within 2 turns and is a normal or elite enemy, [gold]Capture[/gold] it.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
COMICCHESS-SPINNING_KICK.title: Spinning Kick
COMICCHESS-FABRICATE.title: Fabricate
COMICCHESS-FABRICATE.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Create [blue]1[/blue] defensive robot card and [blue]1[/blue] offensive robot card.
COMICCHESS-PROTRUDING_SPIKES.title: Protruding Spikes
COMICCHESS-GOOP.title: Goop
COMICCHESS-TOXIC_CARD.title: Toxic
COMICCHESS-STICKY_SHOT.title: Sticky Shot
COMICCHESS-ILLUSION2.title: Illusion II
COMICCHESS-SLAM.title: Slam
COMICCHESS-GUARD.title: Guard
COMICCHESS-NOISE.title: Noise
COMICCHESS-NOISE.description:
Defensive.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Draw 1 card. Next turn, draw 1 card. Enchant both cards with: [purple]Dazed[/purple].
[gold]Fade[/gold]
COMICCHESS-STAB.title: Stab
COMICCHESS-STAB.description:
Offensive.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Deal {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage. The target loses {LearnIntentStrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
[gold]Fade[/gold]
COMICCHESS-ZAP.title: Zap
COMICCHESS-GIMME.title: Gimme
COMICCHESS-GREMLIN_STAB.title: Gremlin Stab
COMICCHESS-GREMLIN_STAB.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] deals {Damage:diff()} damage to the target. Steal {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
COMICCHESS-FLEE.title: Flee
COMICCHESS-FLEE.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] leaves combat. Add stolen [gold]Gold[/gold] to combat rewards.
COMICCHESS-TACTICAL_DIRECTIVE.title: Tactical Directive
COMICCHESS-TEAR_SPACE.title: Tear Space
COMICCHESS-TIME_TRICK.title: Time Trick
COMICCHESS-TIME_TRICK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Mark up to 2 cards.
At the start of your next turn, return those cards to your hand.
COMICCHESS-PAPER_CUTS.title: Paper Cuts
COMICCHESS-PAPER_CUTS.description:
Does not add to your deck.
On pickup, all enemies in future combats lose 2 Max HP.
COMICCHESS-TREASURE_PAVILION.title: Treasure Pavilion
THE_QUEEN_CARD_TREASURE_PAVILION.selecti: Choose 1 non-Bound card in your Discard pile.
COMICCHESS-MAGIC_PIGMENT.title: Magic Pigment
COMICCHESS-MAGIC_PIGMENT.description:
Create [blue]{GeneratedCount}[/blue] random color cards and corrode them into [purple]Bound[/purple].
[aqua]Gain 1 Soul Lamp.[/aqua]
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
COMICCHESS-DELEGATE_LABOR.title: Delegate
COMICCHESS-DELEGATE_LABOR.description: Lose all your [gold]Strength[/gold]. Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] gains that much [gold]Strength[/gold].
COMICCHESS-TAKE_OVER.title: Take Over
COMICCHESS-TAKE_OVER.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] loses all [gold]Strength[/gold]. You gain that much [gold]Strength[/gold].
COMICCHESS-PREDATORY_ASSIMILATION.title: Predatory Assimilation
COMICCHESS-PREDATORY_ASSIMILATION.descri: When your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] [gold]Fatally[/gold] kills a normal or elite enemy, [gold]Capture[/gold] it.
COMICCHESS-WRIGGLE.title: Wriggle
COMICCHESS-WRIGGLE.description:
Does not add to your deck.
On pickup, enchant 1 Learn Intent (intent damage) card with [purple]Infested[/purple] 3.
COMICCHESS-LASH.title: Lash
COMICCHESS-SKITTISH.title: Skittish
COMICCHESS-CURL_UP.title: Curl Up
COMICCHESS-CURL_UP.description:
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] gains {AmalgamCurlUpPower:diff()} [gold]Curl Up[/gold].
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Deal {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage. The target loses {LearnIntentStrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
COMICCHESS-REATTACH.title: Reattach
COMICCHESS-TEST_SUBJECT.title: Test Subject
COMICCHESS-TEST_SUBJECT.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] gains [gold]Test Subject Power[/gold] and cycles each turn between [gold]Enrage[/gold], [gold]Painful Stabs[/gold], and [gold]Intangible[/gold].
COMICCHESS-PHEROMONE_SPIT.title: Pheromone Spit
COMICCHESS-CLOSE_DOOR.title: Close Door
COMICCHESS-VITAL_SPARK.title: Vital Spark
COMICCHESS-VITAL_SPARK.description:
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] gains {VitalSparkPower:diff()} [gold]Vital Spark[/gold].
Gain [gold]Contagion[/gold]: Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], all enemies gain double [gold]Strength[/gold].
COMICCHESS-RELOAD_FIRE.title: Reload Fire
COMICCHESS-RELOAD_FIRE.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Gain {LearnIntentBlock:diff()} Block. At the start of next turn, deal {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage.
[purple]Bound[/purple]
COMICCHESS-GRASPING_VINES.title: Grasping Vines
COMICCHESS-GRASPING_VINES.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Next turn, gain [gold]Tangled[/gold]. Your Skill cards cost -1.
COMICCHESS-SMOGGY.title: Smoggy
COMICCHESS-SMOGGY.description:
Cards corroded by Smoggy gain Replay 2.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Next turn, gain Smoggy.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold]
COMICCHESS-SHRIEK.title: Shriek
COMICCHESS-SHRIEK.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] gains [gold]Shriek[/gold] equal to half its current HP.
COMICCHESS-LAY_EGGS.title: Lay Eggs
COMICCHESS-LAY_EGGS.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Learn Intent[/gold]: Create {EggCount} [gold]Tough Egg[/gold] in your hand.
[purple]Bound[/purple]
COMICCHESS-TOUGH_EGG.title: Tough Egg
COMICCHESS-DISINTEGRATION.title: Disintegration
COMICCHESS-DISINTEGRATION.description: At the end of your turn, deal {DisintegrationPower:diff()} damage to all enemies.
COMICCHESS-REJUVENATE.title: Rejuvenate
COMICCHESS-MIND_CLARITY.title: Mind Clarity
COMICCHESS-CRAB_RAGE.title: Crab Rage
COMICCHESS-CRAB_RAGE.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
When your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] falls asleep, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
COMICCHESS-BACK_ATTACK.title: Back Attack
COMICCHESS-BACK_ATTACK.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
Create 1 [gold]Switch Side[/gold].
All enemies gain [gold]Back Attack[/gold].
COMICCHESS-CURSE_OF_KNOWLEDGE.title: Curse of Knowledge
COMICCHESS-CURSE_OF_KNOWLEDGE.descriptio:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
Gain 1 [gold]Knowledge Demon[/gold]. At the start of each combat, choose 1 of [gold]Rejuvenate[/gold], [gold]Mind Clarity[/gold], or [gold]Disintegration[/gold] to execute.
COMICCHESS-LIQUIFY_GROUND.title: Liquify Ground
COMICCHESS-SANDPIT_TUG.title: Sandpit Tug
COMICCHESS-FRANTIC_TUG.title: Frantic Tug
COMICCHESS-SWITCH_SIDE.title: Switch Side
COMICCHESS-SWITCH_SIDE.description: Toggle all enemies' [gold]Back Attack[/gold]: they take [blue]50%[/blue] more damage from you or your [gold]Amalgam[/gold].
COMICCHESS-ADMISSION_TICKET.title: Admission Ticket
COMICCHESS-ADMISSION_TICKET.description: {InCombat:Choose 1 card in your hand for [gold]{Applier}[/gold]. Remove it from this combat; it does not go to a pile.|Choose 1 card in your hand for [gold]Card Source[/gold]. Remove it from this combat; it does not go to a pile.}
COMICCHESS-NIBBLE.title: Nibble
THE_QUEEN_CARD_SCHIZOPHRENIA.title: Schizophrenia
THE_QUEEN_CARD_SCHIZOPHRENIA.description: Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold]. Split the target's [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] into 2 fixed parts and divide their stacks evenly.
